## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

ProfileSyncListenerService (new, extends `WearableListenerService`) — `app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sync/ProfileSyncListenerService.kt`

## Trigger

An incoming Data Layer message on path `/profile-sync` — nothing observes it

## Today

`core-sync`'s `DataLayerMessageChannel` only sends (`MessageChannel.send`); no
`MessageClient.OnMessageReceivedListener` and no `WearableListenerService`
exist anywhere in `:core-sync` or `:app-wear`. `PayloadCodec` (internal to
`:core-sync`) only carries `encode(ProfileSyncPayload)` /
`encode(RecordedRacePayload)` — no `decode` function exists for either.
`ProfileSyncPushService.applyIncoming(payload, raceInProgress, at)`, in
`:core-domain`, already does the replace-wholesale work described (reference
race, watch history, profile fields) but is never called from anywhere in
`:app-wear`. Nothing in `AndroidManifest.xml` (app-wear) declares a service
listening for `com.google.android.gms.wearable.MESSAGE_RECEIVED`.

## Expected

A `WearableListenerService` in `:app-wear`, declared in its manifest with an
intent filter on `com.google.android.gms.wearable.MESSAGE_RECEIVED` and a
data path of `/profile-sync`, decodes the message bytes into a
`ProfileSyncPayload` and calls `ProfileSyncPushService.applyIncoming` with
that payload, the current `raceInProgress` state (from
`RaceRecordingRepository.findInProgress()`), and the current instant — so a
profile, full reference and summarised history pushed on `/profile-sync`
replace the watch's state as a whole.

Two things the fix needs are missing and are second gaps of their own:

- A `decode` function for `ProfileSyncPayload` — `PayloadCodec` only encodes
  today, on either payload type.
- `PayloadCodec` is declared `internal` to `:core-sync`; as it stands, even
  once a `decode` function exists, the new listener service in `:app-wear`
  cannot reach it across the module boundary. Decoding has to be exposed
  through a public entry point in `:core-sync` that `:app-wear` can call —
  a receiving counterpart to `ProfileSyncTransport`, or a public function on
  `PayloadCodec` itself.
